declarations.text:
I confirm that I have made clear which facts and matters referred to in this report are within my own knowledge and which are not. Those that are within my own knowledge I confirm to be true. The opinions I have expressed represent my true and complete professional opinions on the matters to which they refer.

I understand that proceedings for contempt of court may be brought against anyone who makes, or causes to be made, a false statement in a document verified by a statement of truth without an honest belief in its truth.

deviations: The case bar's subtitle: the board shows a case description and trial month; the API has neither, the page shows the case type and due date. The artboard is rendered with the page's subtitle (artboardCss). Bar overrides are scoped to trial screens in trial.css (52px hit areas stay).

Only the top 1000px are compared (the artboard is 1000px; the page scrolls). The bottom bar (summary, Download PDF, Print trial pack) is styled from the board but sits further down because the page has the note check and the witness-box copy under the checklist.

Readiness sheet: the API gives each question one 'point against' and one reply, so the board's second and third rows, and the page chips inside the reply (p.214 not yet in trial bundle), are hidden on the artboard (artboardCss). Gap: reply text carries no page references and a sheet has one point.

The sheet's footer line ('Mrs A · Trial pack · Page 44 of 54') has no data (the pack's page positions are not in the preview): the page puts the 'Change my reply' link in that footer line, so the sheet has the board's height. The footer text differs.

The joint statement and the written answers are one row, as drawn; ticking it sets both sections (they stay separate on the server). Hints follow the board where the page has the data; 'Including your note on the referral date' and 'Bolam, Bolitho, Montgomery...' and 'NICE NG12...' are case/pack specifics the preview does not give, so the page keeps generic hints.
The lead says 'Built for the trial from 14 June 2027' from the case's hearings (trial type first), and falls back to 'Made on ...' without one.

'Nothing new on the day' is drawn as a result of the note check (the board shows it standing): the mock answers run a check first, so the callout stands where the board draws it. The check form opens under it; 'Tell the solicitor' and 'Leave it out' keep 52px hit areas.
Preview arrows are drawn 44px with a 52px hit area (pseudo-element); the checkbox rows' native boxes are the board's 24px.
